original_text: <!-- (Audio) Brian: Great idea. To write comments, you simply need to use double slashes to start a comment. Then, you can describe what the code does so that other people can understand it, too. -->
translated_text: <!-- (Audio) Brian: Odlična ideja. Da biste napisali komentare, jednostavno morate koristiti dvostruke kose crte za početak komentara. Zatim, možete opisati šta kod radi kako bi ga drugi ljudi takođe razumeli. -->
